titles.native: 「雨色ココアシリーズ　『あめこん!!』

description:
The fourth season of Ameiro Cocoa.

Rainy Cocoa's Hawaiian coffee shop is now struggling, so the owner Amami brings back a Shiba Inu named Nana to be their mascot. It turns out Nana has the special ability to sniff out good coffee.

(Source: Anime News Network)
